rule: a file may reference only files in its own or a lower layer

notes.src/ArtifactPolicyIdentity.php: Policy, not adapter: it is the identity a policy load stamps onto a compiled artifact. Its two reads of AdapterSources/CapabilityRegistry are the recorded inversion, not a reason to promote the file.
notes.src/Blocks.php: Policy, not kernel: block markup rewriting is driven by Policy and Tokens. Kept in one layer with Tokens/Shortcodes so the codec cycle resolves inside a layer instead of across two.
notes.src/Canon.php: Kernel by doctrine (canonical JSON/ordering is a primitive). Its single read of Policy is the oldest recorded inversion in the graph and the highest-value one to retire.
notes.src/CanonicalSurfaces.php: Repository: a catalogue over OptionState and SidebarState, so it sits with the state models it enumerates rather than with the planners that consume it.
notes.src/Cli.php: The only surface file. It is the top of the ladder and may reference anything.
notes.src/CodeConfigGrammar.php: Policy (the *Grammar axis) although it validates a Code envelope: its caller is SitePolicyValidator/Policy. The resulting read of Code is recorded rather than resolved by moving the grammar into the repository layer.
notes.src/CodeMaterializer.php: Repository, not engine, despite the *Materializer suffix: it depends only on PathSafety and is used solely by Code. The engine *Materializer family materializes authored state; this one materializes code bytes for the repository half.
notes.src/CodeOwnershipPruner.php: Repository for the same reason as CodeMaterializer: a Code-owned pruner over PathSafety, not an engine apply step.
notes.src/CodeStageTransaction.php: Repository: a Code-owned Db/Ledger transaction, kept with Code so the code half stays internally consistent.
notes.src/DeletionCapabilityResolver.php: Policy (the *Resolver axis), not the Deletion* engine family: it answers a policy question from OptionNameReferenceResolver and is read by Policy itself.
notes.src/DurableFilesystem.php: Kernel by doctrine. Its two upward edges to Publish/PublicationJournal are an artefact of the guarded InitialStateBoundaryException class being declared in three files; the scanner attributes a reference to every declaring file. Recorded rather than hidden, because collapsing that triple declaration is the real fix.
notes.src/Identity.php: Repository: identity is repository-side truth (Uuid + SidebarState + Canon), not an engine operation.
notes.src/IdentityBackup.php: Repository with the rest of the Identity* family. It reads only policy/repository/kernel files, so the placement costs nothing.
notes.src/OptionState.php: Kernel: it depends on Canon alone and is read by 26 files across every layer, including policy grammars. Placing it any higher would invert the *Grammar reads without describing anything true.
notes.src/ReferenceGraph.php: Repository, unlike the Reference* grammar/rules/path files: it is a graph over Snapshot and SidebarState, i.e. compiled repository state.
notes.src/ReferenceKeyspaceGrammar.php: Kernel with the rest of the reference grammar: it depends only on ReferenceRules, and the policy loader that reads it sits above.
notes.src/ReferenceScopeClassifier.php: Kernel: a dependency-free classifier read by Tokens, Shortcodes, Blocks and Capture.
notes.src/ReferenceShapeGrammar.php: Kernel with the rest of the reference grammar (ReferenceRules only).
notes.src/RepositoryDeletionParser.php: Repository with the Repository* family. Its read of the engine Deletion model is a real inversion and is recorded: the parser should take a deletion shape, not the engine type.
notes.src/ShortcodeAlternateRegistrar.php: Policy with Tokens/Shortcodes: it registers policy-declared shortcode alternates.
notes.src/Shortcodes.php: Policy with Tokens/Blocks, for the same reason as Blocks.
notes.src/SidebarState.php: Repository: a state model over Ledger/Snapshot/Db, the same axis as Snapshot and OptionState consumers.
notes.src/StateTreeWalker.php: Repository: a dependency-free walker over compiled state trees, read by Lint.
notes.src/TableGraph.php: Kernel: a dependency-free table dependency graph.
notes.src/Tokens.php: Policy, not kernel, although the four codecs it composes (TextTokenizer, IdentityTokenCodec, StructuredReferenceCodec, UrlQueryReferenceCodec) are kernel: Tokens itself reads Policy to decide what a reference means. Its read of Ledger is the recorded inversion.
notes.src/TypedTableCapture.php: Engine with the rest of the *Capture family even though it only reads kernel files; the recorded Snapshot -> TypedTableCapture edge names the real seam (a repository state model driving engine capture) instead of hiding it behind a convenient placement.
notes.src/TypedTableMaterializer.php: Engine with the rest of the *Materializer family, for the same reason as TypedTableCapture.
notes.src/UserMetaState.php: Kernel: a dependency-free state model, read from the repository and engine layers.
